headline: Microsoft Refreshes Surface Pro and Laptop With Snapdragon X2 Plus
summary: Microsoft refreshed its smaller Surface Pro 12-inch and Surface Laptop 13-inch with Qualcomm's Snapdragon X2 Plus chips, according to The Verge, Engadget and Tom's Hardware. The Verge says the devices keep last year's design but cost more, and that the Surface Pro previously started at $799.99.
